text:
Anish (PM): quick heads-up — Atlata asked for a private onprem rollout with HSM + airgap, wants go-live in ~8 weeks. Need a playbook and must-have/fast-follow list.
Maya (Sales): customer is pushing timeline, they signed MSA conditional on 2-month window. budget approved if we can commit. :grimacing:
Devon (Support): saw their intake form — they need full audit logs exported, SAML + SCIM, and ability to run offline inference. Also single-tenant network.
Eve (Infra Eng): 8 weeks is tight. immediate blockers: HSM integration (we need vendor certs + KMS mapping), airgap packaging, and install-runbook automation. Also need to decide installer: terraform + ansible or kube manifests?
Sam (Security): must confirm HSM model compatibility and attestation. Also need data flow diagram + threat model review before staging access. SOC2 re-check required for onprem SLA.
Maya (Sales): we can offer staged acceptance: PoC in 3 weeks (limited), full prod in 8. they prefer single rollout but would accept staged. helps with contract.
Anish (PM): propose we define "MVP private deploy" vs "Full private". MVP = VPC peering/private control plane + basic KMS integration, no airgap install. Full = airgap + HSM + extended observability. Thoughts?
Devon (Support): MVP must include: cert trust bundle, SAML, basic metrics export, runbook for restore. Otherwise we'll get pages.
Eve (Infra Eng): agree. MVP should avoid airgap complexity. For MVP we can provide container images pulled from customer registry. That cuts time. For Full deploy we need:
```
- offline artifact bundle (tar.gz)
- signed image verification
- install script that runs without internet
- HSM provisioning steps
```
Sam (Security): add: signed SBOM and reproducible build artifacts. We'll need to run our signing process or accept customer's HSM for signing? Clarify.
Maya (Sales): customer insists on BYOK HSM for keys. They want master key in their HSM.
Eve (Infra Eng): BYOK is okay but needs KMS adapter layer. Implementation effort estimate: 2 engineers for 4 weeks to build KMS adapter + test harness.
Anish (PM): let's capture acceptance criteria for the backlog ticket. Draft list: 1) Private control plane reachable via peering or transit 2) SAML auth + SCIM provisioning 3) Token auditing + logs retained X days 4) KMS integration (MVP: cloud KMS; Full: BYOK/HSM) 5) Basic metrics + tracing 6) Runbook + rollback 7) Legal/compliance checklist signed
Devon (Support): add: test plan items: load test at 50rps, KV cache warmup validation, sample prompt QoL checks, and failover to hosted must be tested.
Maya (Sales): pricing note — include one-time integration fee for Full deploy. I'll draft SOW once we have rough ETA and resource ask.
Eve (Infra Eng): dependencies we need from customer: network CIDR ranges, jumpbox details, HSM vendor & certs, registry access for images, install window, ops contacts. If any missing, timeline slips.
Sam (Security): also need compliance contact + any required attestations. We'll schedule an initial security questionnaire.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: PROD-4821 "Atlata private deploy intake" assigned -> eng-infra, devex. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PROD-4821
Anish (PM): next steps: Maya confirm customer OK with staged acceptance and BYOK detail. Eve to draft effort estimate and core deliverables. Sam to schedule security intake. Devon to author support runbook template. I'll combine into a single backlog epic and propose prioritization.
Maya (Sales): pinged customer, they agreed to staged. BYOK confirmed, they own HSM provisioning.
Eve (Infra Eng): I'll post a minimal rollout checklist in the ticket, starting with network and registry access.
Devon (Support): I'll attach runbook template to PROD-4821 and add the test matrix. :ballot_box_with_check:
Sam (Security): booked 30m with customer security on Wednesday.
Anish (PM): timeline draft in ticket: MVP PoC (3w) -> internal staging (5w) -> prod rollout (8w). Flagging risk: HSM cert delays, airgap packaging, legal approvals.
Maya (Sales): acknowledging risk. pushing for "commit to dates if we get all deps in 1 week".
Eve (Infra Eng): note: we should include fallback policy — if full deploy blocked, enable routing to hosted model with data residency controls. adds complexity but keeps app live.
Anish (PM): good call. I'll include fallback in acceptance criteria. Anyone object?
(no replies)
Anish (PM): leaving action items in PROD-4821. tagging folks: @Eve @Sam @Devon @Maya.
